title: Queue runtime history display state
summary: Queue preview rows no longer surface fresh runtime success or skip history as terminal table states when the current backend snapshot says the rows are runnable.
reason: After output files are deleted and the queue source scan is rerun, the queue snapshot can correctly place a source back in the runnable set while the runtime event history still contains a recent job_completed record. The WebView table mapped completed/skipped operator state to Done, so some requeued rows still looked done.
behavior_before: Fresh runtime outcomes with success=true produced a completed operator status state, and fresh skipped outcomes produced a skipped operator status state. The Queue table rendered both states as Done even when the current queue snapshot row was runnable.
behavior_after: Fresh runtime success and skip outcomes remain visible as runtime evidence and review guidance, but runnable snapshot rows report a warning operator status state instead of completed or skipped. Explicit runtime failure statuses still report failed.
